summary:
The Earth-to-Planet Space Mission Simulator is an interactive 3D space exploration project that allows users to experience virtual space travel.

Users can select different planetary missions, launch their rocket from Earth, control its movement during space travel, and reach their selected destination.

The project provides an immersive space environment with realistic-looking planets, rocket movement, camera tracking, and mission progress monitoring.

Its main purpose is to make space exploration interesting, educational, and interactive.
